title: How George Leslie is driving productivity through connected construction
summary: Faced with a manual and time-consuming survey data process, with a lack of connectivity between field and office negatively impacting productivity levels and collaborative decision-making, George Leslie chose to partner with Trimble on a new connected workflow.
